overview_description.description: Wiom delivers an asset-light digital platform that enables individuals and small Internet Service Providers to resell home broadband as minute- or day-sized sachet internet packs starting at just ₹5. It operates as India’s licensed Public Data Office Aggregator (PDOA) under the government’s PM‑WANI initiative, aggregating surplus bandwidth from local operators and redistributing it affordably. The platform supports pay‑as‑you‑go usage, allowing hosts to earn while often eliminating their own internet costs. Wiom targets underserved urban, Tier II/III, and rural areas through partnerships with hundreds of local operators and leverages proprietary backend software and router firmware for seamless service delivery.
